title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Route agent-to-agent communication by canonical agent name
goal: Let every admitted agent address any peer by stable canonical name rather than model, provider, admission, or deployment identifiers.
required_outcome: Resolve canonical A2A names through the authoritative live roster at the Runtime boundary while retaining immutable internal identities for authorization, persistence, audit, replay, migration, and compatibility.
acceptance_criteria:
- Any admitted ordinary agent can contact another by canonical name and receive a model-generated reply.
- Missing, malformed, self-targeted, unknown, and ambiguous names return explicit typed errors.
- Backing-model replacement and migrate/freeze-dry/rehydrate preserve the canonical A2A address.
- History exposes canonical sender and recipient names while retaining correlated internal audit identities.
- Provider prompts, tools, schemas, and orientation teach names rather than model or deployment IDs.
- Retained legacy recipient IDs remain bounded compatibility input without becoming public output.
inputs:
- GitHub issue #718.
- Existing governed A2A initiation and closed-loop reply paths.
- Canonical agent naming and authoritative live roster.
- ACIP signing, history, migration, API, and Observatory projections.
target_files_surfaces:
- Runtime roster and A2A recipient resolution
- Provider action/tool prompt and public API schemas
- ACIP/A2A history and Observatory-facing projections
- Migration/checkpoint compatibility and focused tests
- Versioned Welcome Package naming guidance
validation_plan: Run focused canonical-name resolution, denial, compatibility, history, migration, provider-prompt, OpenAPI, and full pairwise resident A2A tests; formatting, diff hygiene, and bounded review.
demo_proof_requirements: Deterministic governed end-to-end proof must show ordinary resident agents addressing peers by canonical name and receiving model-generated replies; helper-only resolution proof is insufficient.
non_goals:
- No Shepherd-specific routing.
- No weaker signed ACIP validation.
- No backing-model changes.
- No distributed transport design.
- No new identity authority.
notes_risks: Avoid conflating display names with canonical names or exposing internal IDs. Resolution must be unique at use time and old persisted records must remain readable.
